name: business-wiki
description: Wiki-as-source-of-truth for business rules, with derived rules JSON + OpenAPI and keeper agents.

wiki_root.title: Wiki root
wiki_root.description: Directory holding the wiki. It is the source of truth.

rules_root.title: Rules root
rules_root.description: Directory holding the derived machine-readable rules.

openapi_path.title: OpenAPI file
openapi_path.description: Derived OpenAPI document. Leave empty for projects with no HTTP surface.

contract_source.title: Code contract source
contract_source.description: Path the openapi-keeper reads real endpoints from (e.g. worker/src, src/routes, app/controllers).

strict_check.title: Fail on validator warnings
strict_check.description: "true" makes warnings fatal in the validators.
